mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with hydrocortisone (corticosteroid) increases risk of hypertensive crisis, especially with higher corticosteroid doses or prolonged use, due to sympathomimetic activity and MAOI potentiation of catecholamine effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective hydrocortisone dose with close blood pressure monitoring and patient education on hypertensive crisis warning signs.
